comment: Values approximate; verify against NASA sources.
notes: Code generated with AI assistance (Claude). Reviewed by team. The delta-v map from the old Sim Spec section 2, as data. All values in m/s. A mission profile lists the legs flown outbound and, if the mission needs a return, the return legs. Required delta-v = outbound legs - Earth rotation bonus (if the profile allows it) + orbit raise (Hohmann from the parking orbit) + return legs, all times (1 + margin).

earth_rotation.source: Old Sim Spec section 2 (launch site bonus). Earth's equatorial rotation speed is about 465 m/s.

margins.source: safe_range_ratio is from Sim Spec v2 section 2.3. default_margin_fraction (3%) is MADE UP: the spec says 'plus a margin' without a number.

legs.name: Ground to suborbital hop (about 190 km apogee)
legs.source: MADE UP estimate, not in the spec's map: Mercury-Redstone burnout speed of about 2.3 km/s plus roughly 1.0 km/s of gravity and drag losses.
